name: Python analysis
description: Run Python in a kernel shared by the composer and the agent, with inline output, a Variables pane and DataFrame tables.

items.name: python_run_cell
items.description: Run code in the workspace's kernel, the same one the user's composer uses.

items.name: python_restart
items.description: Restart the kernel, clearing its namespace.

items.name: python_get_variables
items.description: List the kernel's variables with type, shape and a short preview.

items.name: python_describe_dataframe
items.description: Summarise a DataFrame: columns, dtypes, missing values and basic statistics.

items.name: python_page_dataframe
items.description: Return rows of a DataFrame by offset and count.

items.name: python_save_figure
items.description: Save the current figure to a file in the workspace.

requires.install_hint: install Python 3 with the ipykernel package (pip install ipykernel)
